description: This file defines a runtime validator function validateBucket for checking the existence and accessibility of a Supabase Storage bucket. It imports the Supabase client, extracts project reference info from environment variables, and attempts to list the root directory of the specified bucket. The function provides detailed debugging output and error messages to facilitate diagnostics.

methods.name: getProjectRef()
methods.description: Extracts the project reference from the REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL environment variable.

methods.name: validateBucket(bucketSlug)
methods.description: Public async function that validates the existence and accessibility of a specified Supabase Storage bucket by attempting to list its root directory.
